threads.body: This extractor is also used when `_MessagesStreamMixin._stop()` finalizes streamed responses (`wrappers.py:123-126`), but the new reasoning-token assertions only cover non-streaming calls and no stream cassette contains `output_tokens_details`. Add sync and async streaming coverage (or a stream-finalization unit test) that asserts `gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens`, so this shared path cannot regress silently.
